claim: A bounded database-backed service can use current ClayCode G9 record/rule/cycle/effect-reference semantics and deterministic lowering through a typed host DB adapter to realize CRUD, parameter binding and atomic commit/rollback without a database-specific ClayCode core primitive; canonical semantic identity should remain separate from concrete DB resource/connection identity.
verification_requirement: Repeat one frozen canonical DB-service IR on target Ubuntu through the production parser/type-effect/compiler chain and at least two DB adapters, with crash/recovery, isolation/concurrency, structured error, capability confinement and differential receipts.
falsifier: A realistic APP-03 service exposes a required transaction/query/resource semantic distinction that cannot be represented by existing ClayCode plus a typed adapter, or a guest gains database/filesystem authority outside the declared host grant.
notes: Current mesh preflight governance still has clay->clayresearch drift, and this run used a non-target local sandbox; no APP-03/BASE promotion is implied.
